name: DTB Warmup Countdown
description: Warmup card with a live countdown (duration in minutes or target clock time). White card, black text, red DTB Turnerkreuz logo, corner of choice (top/bottom, left/right). Play starts the countdown, Stop hides it.

endTime.title: Optional: end at clock time (H:MM or HH:MM)
endTime.description: If set, the countdown runs to this time of day (local time of the playout machine) instead of using the duration.

customActions.name: Restart countdown
customActions.description: Restart the countdown from the full duration (or the end time).
